listingMustHaves: 7+ high-quality images (main white BG + lifestyle + packaging + features + size scale + ingredients + variations)

5 bullet points highlighting material, usage, quantity, benefit, certification
A+ Content with rich images and detailed descriptions
Competitive pricing (10-15% below top competitors for launch)

platforms.name: Blinkit
platforms.bestFor: Quick-commerce impulse purchases. Best for candles, camphor, and small incense packs.
listingTips: Keep packs small and affordable (₹99-₹299 range)
Use bright, eye-catching listing images
Focus on instant-use products (small packs, trial sizes)
Highlight '10-minute delivery' benefit in descriptions
Run platform-specific promotions during festivals

platforms.name: Zepto
platforms.bestFor: Quick-commerce targeting urban professionals. Fastest-growing platform.
listingTips: Optimize for 'late-night' and 'emergency' searches
Premium positioning works well (customers pay for speed)
Bundle products (e.g., candle + matches, incense + holder)
Use lifestyle imagery that resonates with young urban audience
Keep inventory in dark stores for fastest delivery

platforms.name: Ajio
platforms.bestFor: Fashion-forward home products. Targets style-conscious, younger audience.
listingTips: Focus on aesthetic packaging and design-forward presentation
Style products as lifestyle accessories, not just functional items
Use aspirational imagery and model shots
Participate in Ajio sales events (End of Season, Festival Sales)
Highlight gifting potential with gift-ready packaging

platforms.name: Reliance Retail (JioMart)
platforms.bestFor: Mass-market reach across India. Strong in Tier 2-3 cities.
listingTips: Price competitively — value-conscious audience
Multi-pack family bundles sell well (e.g., 6-month supply)
Use Hindi + English descriptions for wider reach
Leverage Reliance's offline store network for omnichannel
Focus on traditional products: camphor, agarbatti, dhoop
recommendedProducts: Economy incense stick bulk packs (₹149-₹249 for 200+ sticks)

optimizationChecklist: Professional product photography with white background for main image
Lifestyle and in-use imagery (2-3 images per product)
Keyword research using Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Amazon Brand Analytics
Competitor analysis: top 5 listings in each category
Pricing strategy: competitive launch price, then optimize based on conversion
Inventory planning: 4-6 weeks of stock at all times
Review strategy: Vine Program, follow-up emails, insert cards
A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content for all listings
Festival readiness: stock up 2 weeks before Diwali, Navratri, Ganesh Chaturthi
